usage: invespend pay-selftest [-h] --beneficiary BENEFICIARY --amount AMOUNT
                              [--source SOURCE] [--reference REFERENCE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --beneficiary BENEFICIARY
                        Registered Investec beneficiaryId to pay (never an
                        account number)
  --amount AMOUNT       Amount to pay (e.g. 1.00); subject to the per-payment
                        + daily caps
  --source SOURCE       Last-3 digits selecting the source account (omit if
                        you have one account)
  --reference REFERENCE
                        Optional payment reference
